title: Case 006: Where Is the Policy Being Processed?
initial_request: I previously gave my consent for the application for 106 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 6ZZ. Could you check where things stand and let me know whether the policy documents have been issued?
overview: Lewis Reed asked Oakmere Cover agent Ava for an update after previously giving consent for the application. Ava recorded that the document-issue status was unknown and asked Northmere Mutual to check. Northmere Mutual confirmed that the application was undergoing data checks; Ava relayed that status to Lewis, who confirmed receipt.

next_action.summary: Check the application's current status with Northmere Mutual.

outcome: Lewis was informed that Northmere Mutual confirmed the application was undergoing data checks; no policy issue was confirmed.

events.body: I gave my consent for the application for 106 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 6ZZ earlier, but I have not had an update. Can you check whether the policy documents have been issued?
Lewis Reed called to ask about the application status. His consent was passed on earlier, but I do not yet know whether Northmere Mutual has issued any policy documents.

Please check the current status of Lewis Reed's property insurance application for 106 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 6ZZ. The client's consent was previously passed on, and we need to know whether the application is still being processed or whether documents have been issued.
We confirm that the application for 106 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 6ZZ is undergoing data checks. We are not confirming that policy documents have been issued.
Northmere Mutual has confirmed that your application for 106 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 6ZZ is undergoing data checks. They have not confirmed that policy documents have been issued.
Thanks, I have received your update that the application is undergoing data checks.
